database_scope: single-temperature enthalpy FVM properties; Ag flow properties stored for a later stage

Ag.thermal_conductivity_policy: separate solid/liquid interpolation tables; no interpolation across Tm; linear phase-fraction blend only inside 1 K numerical interval
Ag.liquid_conductivity_status: Ho recommended/provisional estimate; no direct molten-Ag thermal-conductivity experiment in supplied Ho copy; estimated uncertainty about 20 percent

Ti3SiC2.density_policy: fixed 4500 kg/m^3; no thermal expansion or structural change
Ti3SiC2.expansion_note: CSV value alpha_volume=8.90e-6 K^-1 is not the tensor-derived volumetric coefficient; 2 alpha_a+alpha_c is about 26.95e-6 K^-1

source_notes: Pankratz compiled heat of fusion is 11296.8 J/mol; Feber and Cagran experimental values are preserved as alternatives, not averaged.
Stage 4 database and checksums remain unchanged; v2 is an independent candidate.
Pankratz data above 1600 K are marked as source extrapolation; Ti3SiC2 solver stops at 1473.15 K.
